content_sections.heading: Seats by Trade
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification offers a total of 1 vacancy for the Library Trainee position at the Shri Narayan Rao Melgiri Memorial National Law Library, National Law School of India University, Bengaluru.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess a Master’s degree in library and information science or equivalent from a recognized University or Institute. Excellent general skills with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word), KOHA, DSPACE and IT skills. Cataloguing resources as per MARC & AACR II standards. No prior experience is required. Freshers are preferred. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: The selected Library Trainee will receive a consolidated honorarium which will be commensurate with qualification and will be Rs. 20,000 per month. This is a contractual position for a period of six months from the date of appointment, based in Bengaluru, and may be extended if required. Selected candidates will be given training in all sections of the library. They are expected to spend a considerable amount of time cataloguing resources as per MARC & AACR II standards. The library operates from 9:00 AM to 12:00 Midnight, and the selected candidates may be required to work in shifts on a rotational basis, including weekends and holidays.

content_sections.heading: NLSIU Library Trainee Job Description
content_sections.text: The Library Trainee will work closely with the librarians at NLSIU and will be responsible for the following tasks: Catalogue Management (KOHA & Manual Records): Undertake copy cataloguing using Z39.50 (Library of Congress), edit and standardise records as per MARC21 and RDA/AACR2, correct bibliographic fields (author, title, edition, publication, pagination, subjects, classification), verify holdings data, and update legacy records where automated data is unavailable (1st Priority). Digitised Collections Management (Calibre): Review scanned PDFs for completeness and quality, add and standardise metadata, and update accession numbers, call numbers, and edition details to ensure accurate digital records (2nd Priority). DANS (Institutional Repository) Maintenance (DSpace): Correct dissertation titles and URLs, update abstracts, and complete or refine metadata to enhance accuracy, consistency, and discoverability (Last Priority).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NLSIU Library Trainee
content_sections.text: Applicants must submit their application through the designated Google form. Prepare an updated Curriculum Vitae (CV). Draft a Statement of Purpose (not more than 500 words) explaining your interest in and suitability for the role. Gather details of two professional references, or submit two faculty references if you are a fresher. Submit your application along with all required documents through the designated Google form on or before 9 November 2026 (5 PM IST).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications received through the designated Google form. Candidates shortlisted for interview will be intimated through email. For any queries, please write to [email protected] .
